purpose: Repair an observed loss of subquery source documents at final top5; source coverage is not answer correctness
corpora: reviewed10-PDF pilot plus source-only native overlay

cases.question: What is the responsibility of the Receiving Clerk?
Receiving Clerk responsibility and purchase document
Quantum warehouse regulation and Martian fish law

model_policy: Reuse pinned local BGE-M3 and bge-reranker-v2-m3 on CPU float32; same original-window validator; no download/rebuild/alternate model
pool_selection: Bound fusion to at most60 source-verified input IDs; retain20. If unscoped executed subqueries identify distinct original PDF SHA groups, retain their highest fusion-ranked group representative inside20 while preserving global fusion best. Record every replacement.
final_selection: Rerank the entire selected20 pool within40pairs once, retaining full ranked output. Keep global reranker best and at most one highest-ranked representative per distinct PDF group identified by executed subquery top1. Fill remaining slots by original ranking; return in that ranking order. Scoped and no-decomposition routes preserve ordinary ranking. Lower k explicitly reports capacity/unmet groups.
boundary: Source groups are derived only from returned verified subquery candidates, never a supplied expected document/answer label. SHA identity avoids counting identical PDF bytes under different names. Different PDF bytes with equivalent meaning are not detected as families.
control: Load exact hash-checked eaf8fb21 Agent source as a trusted local module. Both baseline and fixed execute genuine reranker forward passes; query-route outputs may be shared through a declared in-memory cache to isolate policy. Do not reuse historical logits.
repeatability: For every case, run the fixed pure pool/final selector twice on the same recorded genuine routes/ranked candidates and require exact ID/order/trace equality; synthetic tests cover input order/rank ties, capacity, scope, lineage and provenance rejection.
metrics: unique original-PDF SHA groups and document names in top5
executed-subquery top1 source-group coverage in top5
promoted/displaced IDs and missing candidate groups
cold loads, declared cache status, per-route wall latency and peak process working set
answer_access: No provided30 question/answer/reference-label file or previous QA prediction payload is opened; diagnostic questions above are source-derived development probes. Neither retriever nor selector receives expected-source or answer labels.
reader_boundary: Only bounded unique source context and quote/schema validation tests; no Qwen/vision/semantic-support inference. All Agent supported_answer and answer_generated remain false.
reporting: Report both corpora and all five cases, including no gain, displaced evidence and unrelated-source promotion. No parameter tuning from these observations, blind-test claim, answer accuracy or award claim. Fixed then baseline inference order is declared, not counterbalanced hardware timing.
